chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Dawud ibn Ishaq, Abu Suleyman al-Hadda', from Muhammad ibn al-Fayd, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The best of oils is the frankincense oil.'

key_terms.الْبَانُ: Frankincense (Boswellia tree/resin, used here to denote frankincense oil)

ai.seo_question: What is considered the best type of oil according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) praises frankincense oil (*dahn al-ban*) as the best oil, reflecting the Shia tradition of valuing natural remedies for both physical health and spiritual purity. This endorsement aligns with the broader Prophetic emphasis on using pure, fragrant substances for anointing and skincare, reinforcing the concept of *tayyibat* (good things) in daily practice.
